scope: Pinned fence and read-only Ecto Repo, real PostgreSQL and real shared row lock, inert selection, verified projection and external CAS.

observations.commit_ack_loss: Final SELECT returned ReadyForQuery:T. PostgreSQL returned CommandComplete COMMIT and ReadyForQuery:I. The proxy withheld both and closed the client socket. DBConnection raised DBConnection.ConnectionError. The pointer advanced once. Baseline reported unavailable. Patch reported indeterminate.
observations.generic_rollback: The proxy replaced ReadyForQuery:T after the final SELECT with ReadyForQuery:E. Postgrex issued ROLLBACK and DBConnection returned {:error, :rollback}. The pointer advanced once. Baseline reported unavailable. Patch reported indeterminate.
observations.controls: Normal acknowledgement applied. Lock contention was busy. Missing lock function and lost BEGIN acknowledgement were unavailable. All three pre-CAS controls skipped CAS. Certain conflict stayed conflict, including when the rollback acknowledgement was dropped.
observations.verification: All eight patched cases passed. Each case reacquired the row with FOR UPDATE NOWAIT and checked for leaked caller state. Elixir formatting passed. git apply --whitespace=error on the exact base file matched the tested code byte for byte.
observations.cleanup: Both disposable PostgreSQL clusters shut down with exit 0 and the socket removed. The fixture processes and their proxy listeners closed. Database and build scratch was removed.

limitations: Generic rollback used an injected protocol status. COMMIT acknowledgement was emitted by real PostgreSQL. The cross-runtime replay was outside the focused control.
